before:
swift:
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      # runner-images macos-15-arm64/20260907.0337 includes this installation;
      # its default Xcode 16.4 supplies Swift 6.1 and cannot build the CLI.
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_26.3.app/Contents/Developer
      TOOLCHAINS: com.apple.dt.toolchain.XcodeDefault
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Builder boundary fixtures read the independently reviewed native pin.
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Retain source and every policy manifest; omit unrelated old receipts.
          # Complete framing seals, envelope pack and external test inputs remain.
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/verification/*
            /verification/**/Package.swift
            /verification/**/Package.resolved
            /verification/**/Cargo.toml
            /verification/**/Cargo.lock
            /verification/**/package.json
            /verification/**/package-lock.json
            /verification/**/go.mod
            /verification/**/go.sum
            /verification/**/build.gradle
            /verification/**/build.gradle.kts
            /verification/**/settings.gradle.kts
            /verification/runtime-review/
            /verification/guest-capability-contract/
            /verification/swift-ordered-retention-analyzer-library/
            /verification/swift-ordered-retention-analyzer-library-review/
            /verification/swift-envelope-ci-pack/
            /verification/envelope-producer-timeout-experiment/candidate_runner.py
            /verification/envelope-producer-timeout-experiment/overlay.json
            /verification/envelope-producer-timeout-experiment/producer-partition.json
            /verification/envelope-partition-default-ci-adoption/
            /verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption/
            /verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/envelope-output-ownership-fix-r2/
            /verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/envelope-profile10-rebind-r3/
            /verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/
            /verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/generated-java-ci-integration/bootstrap.py
            /verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/envelope-r2-hosted-actual-review/review.json
            /verification/swift-envelope-ci-root-review/compiler-qualification-selection-amendment.json
            /verification/swift-envelope-ci-root-review/test-lint-selection-amendment.json
            /verification/android-default-appearance-packaging/run-2/created-descriptor.json
            /verification/ui-measured-appearance-v2-contract/mixer-measured-default-v2.json
            /verification/ui-shared-appearance-contract/v2/mixer-default-appearance-v1.json
            /verification/ui-appearance-foundation/design-corpus.json
      - name: Verify and record pinned Apple toolchain
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/verify-apple-toolchain.py \
            --developer-dir "$DEVELOPER_DIR" \
            --xcode-version 26.3 --xcode-build 17C529 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/apple-toolchain.json"
      - name: CI selection regression tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/tests -v
      - name: Policy and acceptance integrity
        run: python3 scripts/check-policy.py
      - name: Accepted standalone analyzer fixture framing
        run: |
          python3 -B scripts/ci/check-analyzer-framing.py \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/analyzer-framing"
      - name: Preserve standalone analyzer framing receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: analyzer-framing-host-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/receipt.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/ownership.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/commands/*
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/source/**/*.rs
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/source/collector.py
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/inputs/historical/*
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-framing/retained/**/*
      - name: Bind reviewed envelope and prospective compiler selection
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption"
          mkdir -p "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs"
          python3 -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/adopt_envelope.py" verify --workflow-installed \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/preflight.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/preflight.stderr"
      - name: Guarded envelope and prospective compiler adoption controls
        timeout-minutes: 3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption"
          python3 -B "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/test_adoption.py" -v \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/controls.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/controls.stderr"
          python3 -I -B -S "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/test_binding.py" \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/caller-controls.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/caller-controls.stderr"
          python3 -I -B -S "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/test_rebind.py" \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/rebind-controls.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/rebind-controls.stderr"
          python3 -I -B -S "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/test_source113.py" \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/source113-controls.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/source113-controls.stderr"
      - name: Standalone analyzer envelope with prospectively selected compiler
        # 480 active + 60 retention/cleanup seconds; 180 seconds startup margin.
        timeout-minutes: 12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0
          MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption"
          MIXER_ENVELOPE_RUSTC_LAUNCHER="$(command -v rustc)"
          python3 -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/adopt_envelope.py" run \
            --rustc "$MIXER_ENVELOPE_RUSTC_LAUNCHER" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/analyzer-envelope" \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/fixture.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/fixture.stderr"
      - name: Verify prospective envelope adoption source postflight
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption"
          mkdir -p "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs"
          python3 -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/adopt_envelope.py" verify --workflow-installed \
            > "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/postflight.stdout" \
            2> "$MIXER_ADOPTION_DIR/logs/postflight.stderr"
      - name: Preserve standalone analyzer envelope receipts
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: analyzer-envelope-host-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/analyzer-envelope/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/verification/envelope-partition-default-ci-adoption/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/verification/envelope-rust-1991-default-ci-adoption/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/envelope-output-ownership-fix-r2/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/envelope-profile10-rebind-r3/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/verification/plan-continuation-2026-11-07/source113-sparse-closure-fix-r2/
            ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/workflows/verify.yml
      - name: Generated capability schema and host lifecycle
        run: |
          python3 capabilities/tools/generate.py --check
          swift test --package-path capabilities
      - name: Guest transport raw byte corpus
        run: |
          python3 capabilities/tools/check-guest-transport-fixtures.py --configuration debug
          python3 capabilities/tools/check-guest-transport-fixtures.py --configuration release
      - name: Native HTTP, deadlines and exit ownership under Thread Sanitizer
        run: |
          swift test --package-path capabilities \
            --scratch-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/capability-tsan" --sanitize thread \
            --filter 'NativeCapabilityExitTests|NativeHTTPTransportTests|CapabilityHostDeadlineTests|CapabilityCarriedDeadlineTests'
      - name: Swift SDK, update verifier and CLI
        run: |
          swift --version
          python3 scripts/ci/check-sdk-package.py
          swift test
          swift test --package-path updates
          swift build --package-path cli --product mixer -j 2
          MIXER_STORE_CLI_BIN_DIR="$(swift build --package-path cli --product mixer -j 2 --show-bin-path)"
          test -x "$MIXER_STORE_CLI_BIN_DIR/mixer"
          MIXER_STORE_TEST_CLI="$MIXER_STORE_CLI_BIN_DIR/mixer" swift test --package-path cli
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s cli/build-tests -v
          swift test --package-path native/android/engine
          python3 runtime-identity/tools/vectors.py --check
          python3 runtime-identity/tools/vectors_v2.py --check
          swift test --package-path runtime-identity
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s runtime-identity/build-tools/tests -v
      - name: Statically linked owned VM and signed startup
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest discover -s runtime/build-tests -v
          python3 runtime/build-vm.py --revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --target host --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-vm"
          swift test --package-path runtime -Xlinker "-L$RUNNER_TEMP/native-vm/lib"
          swift test --package-path activation -Xlinker "-L$RUNNER_TEMP/native-vm/lib"
          swift test --package-path verification/runtime-review -Xlinker "-L$RUNNER_TEMP/native-vm/lib"
      - name: Generated consumer integration
        run: |
          swift run --package-path cli mixer create VerificationApp --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/VerificationApp"
          swift run --package-path cli mixer test --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/VerificationApp"
          swift run --package-path cli mixer build --platform ios --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/VerificationApp"
      - name: Preserve core Apple toolchain and owned VM receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: swift-core-toolchain-host-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/apple-toolchain.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/native-vm/receipt.json
